note: Fixed before the first candidate run (docs/CANDIDATE_RUNS.md, #437). One entry per candidate of status ready, fixable or two_step in data/candidates/papers.json. `listed_command` is the command of the owner's lists (data/candidates/input.json). `command` is what is run: equal to the listed command, except where the listed command holds a placeholder (`...`, `<...>`), which is completed only from the README at the pinned commit (`source`). The plan is never changed after a run.
